title: Difference of squares & perfect squares平方差与完全平方

quiz.q: Factor 36x2−60x+25.分解因式 36x2−60x+25。
opts: (6x−5)(6x+5)
(6x+5)2
(6x−5)2
(12x−5)(3x−5)
quiz.hint: 36x2=(6x)2, 25=52, and 2(6x)(5)=60x.36x2=(6x)2，25=52，且 2(6x)(5)=60x。
quiz.why: Correct: A=6x, B=5, 2AB=60x.正确：A=6x，B=5，2AB=60x。
whys: That is 36x2−25 — a difference of squares has no middle term.那是 36x2−25——平方差没有中间项。
Sign slip: the middle term is −60x, so the bracket has a minus.符号错：中间项是 −60x，括号里应是减号。
Correct: A=6x, B=5, 2AB=60x.正确：A=6x，B=5，2AB=60x。
Ends multiply right but the middle is −75x; always check the middle.首尾积对了，但中间项是 −75x；一定要验中间项。

quiz.q: Factor fully: 81x4−16.完全分解：81x4−16。
opts: (9x2−4)(9x2+4)
(9x2+4)(3x−2)(3x+2)
(3x−2)2(3x+2)2
(9x2−4)2
quiz.hint: 81x4=(9x2)2 and 16=42.81x4=(9x2)2，16=42。
quiz.why: Correct: (9x2−4)(9x2+4), then 9x2−4=(3x−2)(3x+2); the sum stays.正确：(9x2−4)(9x2+4)，再 9x2−4=(3x−2)(3x+2)；平方和保留。
whys: Stopped early: 9x2−4 is again a difference of squares.停得太早：9x2−4 还是平方差。
Correct: (9x2−4)(9x2+4), then 9x2−4=(3x−2)(3x+2); the sum stays.正确：(9x2−4)(9x2+4)，再 9x2−4=(3x−2)(3x+2)；平方和保留。
Factored the sum 9x2+4 as if it were a difference.把平方和 9x2+4 当成平方差分解了。
Treated it as a perfect square; (9x2−4)2 has a middle term −72x2.当成了完全平方；(9x2−4)2 会有中间项 −72x2。

quiz.q: Factor 4x2−9y2.分解因式 4x2−9y2。
opts: (2x−3y)2
(4x−9y)(x+y)
(2x−3y)(2x+3y)
(2x+3y)2
quiz.hint: (2x)2−(3y)2.(2x)2−(3y)2。
quiz.ans: (2x−3y)(2x+3y)
quiz.why: Difference of squares with A=2x, B=3y.平方差，A=2x，B=3y。

quiz.q: Factor fully: 50−2x2.完全分解：50−2x2。
quiz.hint: GCF 2 first.先提 2。
quiz.ans: 2(5−x)(5+x)

quiz.q: A square lawn has side s metres. A 2 m wide gravel path is laid around all four sides, outside the lawn, so the lawn and path together form a larger square. The gravel path covers 336 m2. (a) Write the path area as a difference of squares and factor it. (b) Find s. (c) Verify using a mental-math difference of squares.一块正方形草坪边长 s 米。在草坪外侧四周铺一条 2 m 宽的碎石小路，草坪和小路合起来是一个更大的正方形。碎石路面积为 336 m2。(a) 把路面积写成平方差并分解。(b) 求 s。(c) 用平方差心算验证。
quiz.hint: The big square has side s+4, not s+2: the path is on both sides.大正方形边长是 s+4，不是 s+2：两侧都有小路。
quiz.ans: (a) (s+4)2−s2=4(2s+4)=8s+16; (b) s=40 m; (c) 442−402=4⋅84=336.(a) (s+4)2−s2=4(2s+4)=8s+16；(b) s=40 m；(c) 442−402=4⋅84=336。
quiz.why: Path area =(s+4)2−s2=((s+4)−s)((s+4)+s)=4(2s+4)=8s+16.路面积 =(s+4)2−s2=((s+4)−s)((s+4)+s)=4(2s+4)=8s+16。
